sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order WHERE paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND paid_at < '2026-05-01'
SELECT s.name, SUM(o.pay_amount) gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.pay_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) AS arpu FROM trd_order o WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
SELECT r.big_region, SUM(i.pay_share) FROM trd_order_item i JOIN trd_order o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.big_region
WITH m AS (SELECT shop_id, SUM(pay_amount) gmv FROM trd_order GROUP BY shop_id) SELECT shop_id, gmv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) rk FROM m
SELECT o.shop_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS refund_rate FROM trd_order o LEFT JOIN trd_refund rf ON rf.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.shop_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > 100
SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) qty FROM trd_order_item WHERE created_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT CASE WHEN pay_amount >= 500 THEN '高' WHEN pay_amount >= 100 THEN '中' ELSE '低' END AS band, COUNT(*) FROM trd_order GROUP BY band
SELECT member_id FROM trd_order WHERE member_id IN (SELECT id FROM usr_member WHERE level_id >= 3) LIMIT 100
SELECT 'paid' AS k, COUNT(*) FROM trd_order WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'refund', COUNT(*) FROM trd_refund

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM trd_refund WHERE refund_status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT d.year_month_str, SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM trd_order o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at,'%Y-%m') year_month_str, id FROM trd_order) d ON d.id = o.id GROUP BY d.year_month_str
SELECT carrier_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, shipped_at, delivered_at)) AS hours FROM tms_shipment WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trd_order WHERE YEAR(paid_at) = 2026 AND MONTH(paid_at) BETWEEN 2 AND 4;
SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_at)::date AS m, SUM(pay_amount) FROM trd_order GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT shop_id, pay_amount, LAG(pay_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id ORDER BY paid_at) AS prev FROM trd_order LIMIT 50
SELECT s.name, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.pay_amount) FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id = o.shop_id GROUP BY s.name
SELECT o.id FROM trd_order o WHERE o.paid_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' LIMIT 10
WITH a AS (SELECT member_id, MIN(paid_at) first_paid FROM trd_order GROUP BY member_id), b AS (SELECT member_id FROM a WHERE first_paid >= '2026-02-01') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b
SELECT so.warehouse_id, COUNT(*) FROM wms_stockout_record so WHERE so.created_time BETWEEN '2026-10-12' AND '2026-10-18' GROUP BY so.warehouse_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pay_amount > 100) AS big, COUNT(*) AS total FROM trd_order
SELECT p.name AS platform, COUNT(*) FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_platform p ON s.platform_id = p.id WHERE p.name = '抖音' GROUP BY p.name
SELECT x.shop_id, x.gmv FROM (SELECT shop_id, SUM(pay_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order GROUP BY shop_id) x WHERE x.gmv > 10000
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.pay_share - i.cost_price * i.quantity), 2) AS gross_profit FROM trd_order_item i

SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '未知'), COUNT(*) FROM trd_order_item i LEFT JOIN prd_category c ON c.id = i.category_id GROUP BY c.name
